**Verdict: PASS** on the frozen DG5 candidate `sha256:33188e9e…` (2194 files, source `12dc33e`). I confirmed the candidate ID on a complete disposable clone at the start, and again after another reviewer's records were auto-committed to the main repo during my run.

**The two findings I had to verify are both closed:**
- **F-DG5-148 (record names on Traceability and Modular entry): CLOSED_VERIFIED.** I re-ran my round-6 reproduction unchanged, in en and ar and in both locale settings. Both screens now show 0 px of horizontal page scroll at 390 px, 320 px and 200 % text; round 6 measured up to 1658 px. A new asserted probe confirms the two elements the finding named are fixed.
- **F-DG5-149 (Define Good-outcome table): CLOSED_VERIFIED.** The page shows 0 px at 320, 360, 375 and 390 px, where round 6 measured 61, 21 and 6 px. The table sits in a named, focusable region that scrolls with the keyboard, and axe passes.

**New findings (both Low, not mandatory, not blocking DG5; owner frontend-ux-engineer):**
- **F-DG5-150 (REQ-S15-009).** On Traceability, clicking a node's Focus button shows a note: 'Showing the links of <type> "<name>"'. That note prints the name as plain text without the new wrapping rule. An unbroken name therefore still widens the page: 651 px at 390 px, 721 px at 320 px, 1312 px at 200 % text. Wrapping that one note brings every case to 0 px. F-DG5-148 did not name this element, and round 6 never focused a record, so I raised it separately.
- **F-DG5-151 (REQ-PB-091, a test defect).** In the test that failed once in D-182 (`p5-launch-health-kpi.spec.ts:159`), the wait before Submit is unsound. When I slowed the API's responses, that wait matched an earlier, stale response in 6 of 6 runs. The product still sent the correct version every time. This is a plausible but unproven cause of the D-182 failure.

**D-181 picker fix: works.** With 102–103 transformations, 10 picker screens offer both the newest and the oldest, in en and ar and in both locale settings. The dashboard chooser is paged rather than truncated: its total matches the API and search finds the newest.

**D-182 failure: not reproduced.** It passed in 4 full product suites, 10 of 10 targeted runs in Arabic, and runs with the browser slowed 4× or the API responses delayed. I found no product defect; the cause stays unestablished.

**Checks run (all exit 0):**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static (build, typecheck, lint, OpenAPI lint with 846 operations, no-CDN, format, contrast) | all pass |
| Unit tests, Node 22 and Node 24, both locale settings | 2341 + 1722 + 259 passed; 2 skips by design |
| Integration, twice | 3076 passed; 1 skip by design |
| `tests/qa` on its own | 336 passed |
| Product e2e, each locale setting | 460/460 |
| Root acceptance specs / demo specs, each locale setting | 30/30 and 12/12 |
| Read-only auditor tests, each locale setting | 52/52 |
| Accessibility (axe) | 0 violations of any impact |
| REQ-DLV-037 (A06, A07, A15, A16 suites; 26 exported files inspected in en and ar) | all pass |
| Gate validators (register, pipeline, historical DG4 to DG1) | all pass |
| 78 assigned requirements | each maps to named tests, all passing this round |

**Disclosures:**
- The assignment says `round: 5` and task `T-DG5-REV-QA-R5`. The record uses round 7, because the validator requires the round to match the folder.
- Every failing probe log is explained in the record. Picker probe revisions 1–3 failed on probe errors I fixed (one hit a file race in my own harness). The R7-F148 probe's 9 failing cases are exactly the F-DG5-150 overflow. One formatting check was disturbed by my own probe file and passed cleanly on re-run.
- The probe scripts were first written by this role's two earlier round-7 runs, which a container restart stopped. I re-read, corrected and re-ran them; I cite none of those earlier results.
- I could not stop a background job from the shell (each command runs in its own process namespace), so I added a lock to make sure the integration suite ran only once.
- I deleted the disposable clone. A few small lock and output folders remain in this run's scratch directory, which the runner deletes when the run ends.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-7/`:
- `qa-verifier.json`
- `qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `qa-verifier.md`

Evidence is under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/round-7/`, and the probe tests are under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG5/qa/tests/round-7/`.
